venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Friday 7/10 (MOD MKZ/JK; entered by Mya):** FriYay energy. Rain slowed the start but the opener set the team up for success; cut before 8pm with the mid taking over, closers in at 8pm. Nice pop around 9:30pm and stayed consistent. DJ Jamie did a great job as usual and the barback held it down with strong team support. A few garnishes cut mid-shift but service ran smoothly; lots of glasses broken tonight — keep heads on a swivel. Way more comps than normal at the end of the night ($198.80) — reminder to secure payments and address 86's/misrings immediately. Ended the night with tons of Casi Cielo employees who consistently send tables our way. Net $7,717 vs $6,128 target (+25.9%). Food $187. Guests 260, check avg $29.68. Kitchen closed early with a tasty staff meal. Maintenance: loose gasket on freezer behind well 2. Favorite moment: seeing so many early-night guests return.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Hot and humid once again; didn't appear to slow foot traffic in the area
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Friday 7/10 (MOD KK/MD & Chef JMS/KM; entered by JO):** A decent Friday night carried heavily by a 50-top reservation that was in from 7pm–10:30pm and drove most sales — the team felt the party masked what might otherwise have been a slightly slower night. A few guests were inquisitive about the liquor-by-drink tax and were walked through it. Strong food night ($509) — John-Michael and Kevin held down the kitchen and the 50-top spent big on food. Net $10,933 vs $10,072 target (+8.5%). Comps $109.95 (1.0%). Guests ~354, check avg $30.88. Maintenance: NEW Well 4 froster; NEW Well 2 sink pedals sticking (water doesn't stop right away). Favorite moment: a full crew doing the darn thing, with the 50-top as the highlight.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Sunny and hot with a short rain around 5pm
venues.narrative: **DVR — Friday 7/10 (AM Carey/Chef Evan; PM MS/Walcott/Evan; entered by MS):** A solid, cranking Friday — moving, busy and fast all night with one lull around 8:30pm before it was back on. Teams were super dialed with amazing energy and fast table turns; happy full rail all night and Garden crushed. Cafe/AM $919.87 (Felix; 2 IRDs, lots of cleaning, a little cocktail pop late; iPad had trouble connecting to wifi — heads up). D&C PM $19,286.71. Garden/6A $5,832.00 (slow start, very heavy last couple hours; brief rain didn't scare people off). Kitchen: great night with Nate, Lucas and Isaias, good dinner rush ~8pm. Events: small 30th-birthday celebration in Suite 6A 6–9pm (Lucas W ran a taco station/sliders and passed apps, cake + cookie for the birthday girl). Net sales $20,206.58 vs $17,957 target (+12.5%); net incl. events $23,594. Food $2,889.40 (food incl. events $4,429). Net event sales $3,388. Comps $498.22. Guests 391 (+4 last-minute). Incident: yes — reported. Maintenance: bar 500 fridge went from freezing overnight to 55°F (reported in Intelity/maintenance channel). Favorite moment: a near-perfect service the whole team needed.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Friday 7/10 (MOD Kyler/Chef Alejandro; entered by Sean):** Great flow despite a slow start, with several larger parties sequenced through the night to keep energy high. Thomas personalized requests and reached beyond the seasonal menu while balancing 7+ groups; Jane and Peter crushed tickets; Haleigh paced seatings so the team could move with intention. The floor stayed busy right up to last call. Top sellers: Rosalie / Native Lion (tie), Shinebox, 'Gatlin' Gun. Door: humid, properly full by ~7:15pm with a big 8pm turn and a medium waitlist; 10pm turn, a brief lull at 10:30pm, then packed again by 10:50pm; officially slowed at 12:30am but stayed relatively full to 1:15am. Many anniversaries celebrated, plus Missy's last few days as a neighbor; Pete Crowley (Macallan), James with an old bartender friend, plus Max, Koba and Lucas' regulars stopped in. Net $8,213 vs $7,711 target (+6.5%). Food $1,026, beverage $7,161, retail $26. Comps $252.79 (investors/members, F&F, regulars). Guest count did not populate in Sevenrooms (reported 0), so check average is unavailable for the night. Menu count 19/19. Glassware breakage: 3x DOF, 1x N&N, 1x water glass. One no-show (Nick Berglund, party of 2 at 6pm) charged.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Friday 7/10 (MOD Joe/Gigi & Chef Josh/Oscar; entered by Gigi):** Started extremely slow and calm, then cranked into high gear around 8:30pm with a ton of walk-ins and no lulls — turn and burn all night. Like last weekend, lots of large groups but fewer resys, so the team got creative to accommodate them. Member Vincent came in with partner Olivia and Jaz took extra-great care of them. Standing Room was full all night, turned a few times (even the Standing Rail sat), with a 2-top and 7-top as the last SR seatings around 12:45am — thanks Julian, Mikey and Raven for the late close. Several parties sat around last call for food in the Marquee, including another 7-top. Net $12,663 vs $11,884 target (+6.6%). Food $2,087. Marquee $9,444 (food $1,766); Standing Room $3,219 (food $321). Comps $251.30 (walk-out, DNLs, member, birthdays, service recovery). Guests 352, check avg $91.59. Kitchen: oven is back — cookies galore. 86'd tuna crudo. Maintenance: a couple of broken tiles by the host stand worsening; kitchen light fixed. Favorite moment: chatting FIFA with a group waiting upstairs.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Friday 7/10 (MOD Marcus/Josh; entered by Josh):** (Report date field mistyped as 2026-06-10/Saturday; matched to Friday 7/10 by post time.) Slow start due to extreme heat, so the Garden opening was delayed until 7pm; once temps dropped, foot traffic picked up with a steady flow and a good mix of larger groups. A short waitlist at times but the team moved through it quickly and seated everyone inside without issue — smooth, efficient service with quick drinks and good energy. Marquee also steady, picking up ~6:30pm and full by 7:30pm with a healthy mix of resos and walk-ins; a couple of seating hiccups led to slightly longer waits but the room stayed well paced with three servers. Kitchen ran a steady night (~8.6% of sales), mainly snacks, with S/O to James holding it down solo. Marquee $8,671.90, Garden $2,342.27, food $946.24; total sales $11,014.17, total net sales incl. events $9,908.15 vs $7,572 target (+30.9%). Comps $105.65 (1%), voids $123.00 (1.2%). Guests 177, GCA $39.77. What went well: pacing and ticket times. To improve: comms, ABK, product knowledge. No-shows charged. Favorite moment: celebrating Elliott for his last shift.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 7/10 (AM Sam & Chef Lex/Shannon; PM Justin & Chef Marcus/Drew; entered by Alexis):** Morning: a good first hour (~$130) then a quiet 9–11am, with 11–3 steady but manageable; two good-sized food tours, almost no bar-top guests. Evening: started looking like the night before with few covers, but walk-ins made it busy — the business really landed in the second half after 8pm with a good mix of regulars/locals and first-timers, steady until 10pm. Kitchen grooved all night with no crazy pushes; three servers held the floor after 9pm, bar dropped to two bartenders by 9pm and handled it well. Bar nearly empty by 10:30pm, floor cleared by 11:15pm — a good chunk of birthdays and industry. Sun Club: slow, steady hotel-guest business, no guests after 7pm ($502). Hot Eye: very quiet first two hours, then a 180 by 9:30pm nearly filling up for a solid two hours (mostly tourists + some industry), tapering by midnight ($1,619). Net $10,040 vs $8,500 target (+18.1%). Food $2,955. Comps $330. Guests 252 (Muni Bar AM 54 + PM 198; OpenTable). Favorite moment: Kyle Gibbons & partner Bianca — first-ever repeat hotel stay — booked a pop-up and are staying through the weekend while house-hunting in the city.
